settings.heading: Product Specifications
settings.content:
Compact and Stylish Design: Small round ottoman stool with a diameter and height of 28 cm - perfectly sized for use as a footrest, extra seating, or decorative accent in any room.

Durable Wooden Legs: Four sturdy solid wood legs provide stable support and elevate the stool with a natural wood finish for a warm, modern look.

Soft Upholstered Cushion: Comfortable padded top covered with high-quality, breathable fabric that is smooth to touch and visually appealing in light blue soft tones.

Lightweight and Portable: Easy to move around the home or office, making it convenient for versatile placement wherever extra seating or comfort is needed.

Multipurpose Use: Ideal as a footrest, vanity stool, kids' seat, side table, or accent piece. Its clean design complements various interior décor styles.

settings.heading: Product features
settings.content:
Materials: 

Upholstered in high-quality breathable fabric, with padded cushioning for comfort and solid natural wood legs for support.

Care Instructions:

  • Wipe clean with a soft, damp cloth to remove surface dust or stains.
  • Avoid harsh chemicals or abrasive cleaners that may damage the fabric or wood finish.
  • Spot clean fabric with mild detergent if needed, allowing it to air dry naturally.
  • Avoid exposing the stool to direct sunlight or excessive moisture to prevent fading or wood warping.

settings.heading: Materials and care
settings.content:
• Frame: High-grade steel pipe with flush connection technology for precise support, strong load-bearing, and long-lasting durability.
  • Mattress: High-resilience cotton/foam filling encased in breathable plaid fabric or durable oxford cloth for comfort and health.
  • Upholstery: Cover is soft, sweat-absorbent, and non-irritating to skin. It is designed for all-season use, resisting pilling and maintaining shape.
  • Non-Slip Foot Pads: Provide additional safety on a variety of surfaces and protect flooring from scratches.
